name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=inventory, descriptor=remove_slot_at). Accurately describes the behavior: removes the item at a given inventory slot index and shifts the following slots down to close the gap. No Ghidra address residue; the '_at' suffix is meaningful (operates at a caller-supplied slot index).
purpose: Remove the item occupying inventory slot `slot` of runtime_char[char_idx] and close the gap by shifting every following slot down by one, leaving slot 7 stamped vacant.
logic_summary: rc = data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr. memmove(rc[char_idx].inventory_slots + slot*2, rc[char_idx].inventory_slots + slot*2 + 2, (7 - slot) * 2) copies slots[slot+1..7] over slots[slot..6]. Then rc[char_idx].inventory_slots[14] = 0x80 stamps slot 7's flag byte vacant, so the freed slot is always slot 7 regardless of which slot was removed. slot==7 copies 0 bytes and only re-stamps slot 7. Each slot is 2 bytes (inventory_slots[i*2]=flag, [i*2+1]=item_id); flag bit 0x80=vacant, 0x40=equipped. Disasm confirmed: char_idx*0x50 (sizeof runtime_char=80), inventory_slots field at struct offset +0xA, memmove dst=base+slot*2+0xA, src=base+slot*2+0xC, MOV byte [EBX+0x18],0x80 == inventory_slots[14] (0x18-0xA=14). __CHK(0x14) is the compiler-injected stack-probe prologue.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: runtime_char array index of the character whose inventory is edited (0..party_member_count-1). Used to compute &rc[char_idx] (char_idx*0x50 + array base).
params.reason: Live Ghidra param is generic param_1; should match the home-source name char_idx, which describes its role as the runtime_char index. (Rename applied in Stage 2.)

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Inventory slot index (0..7) to remove. Drives both the memmove size ((7-slot)*2) and the shift origin (src=slot+1, dst=slot).
params.reason: Live Ghidra param is generic param_2; should match the home-source name slot, which describes the 0..7 inventory slot index being removed. (Rename applied in Stage 2.)

returns.semantics: No return value; mutates runtime_char[char_idx].inventory_slots in place.
